title: Albert Einstein Biography
text: Albert Einstein was born on March 14, 1879, in Ulm, Germany. He developed the special and general theories of relativity.

title: Google Corporate History
text: Google was founded on September 4, 1998, by Larry Page and Sergey Brin while they were Ph.D. students at Stanford University.

title: Earth Orbit & Astronomical Mechanics
text: The Earth revolves around the Sun in an elliptical orbit taking approximately 365.25 days to complete one revolution.

title: Apollo 11 Mission Overview
text: Apollo 11 was launched on July 16, 1969, and landed the first humans, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

title: COVID-19 Transmission & Clinical Guidance
text: COVID-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Antibiotics do not work against viruses; they only work on bacterial infections.

title: Penicillin Discovery
text: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928 at St. Mary's Hospital in London.

title: Miranda v. Arizona Judicial Ruling
text: In Miranda v. Arizona (1966), the Supreme Court of the United States ruled that detained criminal suspects must be informed of their constitutional rights.

title: Python Programming Language
text: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
